inputs.name: presets
inputs.description: Sample rule files from the audit package to copy into /etc/audit/rules.d, by name without .rules, such as ["11-loginuid", "30-stig"].

inputs.name: rules
inputs.description: Your own audit rules, one per line in auditctl syntax, such as ["-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudoers"]. They go in /etc/audit/rules.d/50-conn3x.rules.

inputs.name: immutable
inputs.description: Lock the rules with -e 2 once they load. Changing them afterwards takes a reboot.

inputs.name: backlog_limit
inputs.description: Audit messages the kernel buffers while auditd catches up (-b).

inputs.name: failure_mode
inputs.description: What the kernel does when it can't record an event (-f): 0 nothing, 1 logs to the kernel log, 2 panics.

inputs.name: auditd_conf
inputs.description: Settings for /etc/audit/auditd.conf, such as { max_log_file = "50", num_logs = "10" }. Settings left out keep their current value.
